text:
Alex P: Quick async check — planning a short cross-team sync on the v2 endpoint compat tomorrow. Who owns the SDK patch for the header change? Also need a final list of services still calling /generate v1.
Mariela G: I can take the SDK patch (JS + Python). ETA EOD Tue. Will open PR and tag @Kevin T for CI.
Kevin T: Thanks — I'll prep infra changes for the proxy header passthrough (eng-infra). Can we avoid breaking beta customers? Need a canary window and rollback criteria.
Samir: We're still running a handful of internal services on v1: billing-worker, rerank-service. I'll send owners and current traffic counts.
Li Chen: Note: Dedicated customers on private deploys won't pick up the feature flag automatically. Need migration guidance for account managers and a support playbook.
Alex P: Action items: (1) Mariela PR for SDK header + release notes, (2) Kevin proxy update + canary for 4h, (3) Samir list owners for billing + rerank, (4) Li draft customer comms. Aim: opt-in flag `v2_compat_mode` for 2 weeks before forced redirect.
Mariela G: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/428 — tests failing on Windows CI, pinging @deploy-bot to re-run.
deploy-bot: CI restart requested by Mariela G — run queued, ETA ~12m.
Kevin T: For the canary I'll add a routing rule pinned to region-us-east-1 and limit to 2% traffic. Revert if p50 or p95 latency increases >20% or error rate >0.5%. Need SRE to watch the dashboards.
Samir: Owners confirmed: billing-worker -> @Tara, rerank-service -> @Joel. I'll DM both for a quick smoke tomorrow.
Li Chen: Drafted comms: short note + migration FAQ. Putting in #marketing for review, will cc account managers and legal for the private deploy blurb.
Mariela G: Plan for compatibility shim in SDKs so both header orders are accepted for a 6-week overlap. Will add unit + e2e tests and a small perf test.
Alex P: Rollout plan: opt-in (flag) -> canary -> 2-week overlap -> deprecation notice -> redirect. We also need an incident playbook with fast rollback steps and a runbook for customer support.
Kevin T: I'll coordinate with eng-sre for monitoring and alerting. @Samir can you confirm availability for canary monitoring 09:00–13:00 PST tomorrow?
Samir: I'm on for 09:00–11:00 PST, @Joel can cover 11:00–13:00 PST.
Alex P: Quick smoke test we can run in canary:
```
curl -H 'X-Redwood-Version: v2' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}'
```
Alex P: Last ask: anyone aware of SDK consumers who depend on v1 header ordering or strict parsing? Drop names here. :eyes:
Tara: billing-worker has a strict parser, will check and patch by EOD.
Mariela G: I'll add a note in the PR about the shim and compatibility tests and add a small migration guide in the repo docs.
Alex P: Thanks all — I'll collate these action items into the migration board and ping again in the morning.
